EC1: - Small ASD [AND] with Qp/Qs <1.5:1 [OR] or [NOT] no signs of RV volume overload
EC2: - A single defect too large for closure (>38 mm)
EC3: - Multiple ASDs [NOT] unsuitable for percutaneous closure.
EC4: - Anterior, [OR] posterior, [OR] superior, [OR] or inferior rim <5 mm.
EC6: - Associated structural heart disease requiring cardiac surgery.
EC7: - ASD [AND] with severe pulmonary arterial hypertension [AND] and bidirectional [OR] or right-to-left shunting.
